services.ifOff: Apps and projects that use this database cannot connect.

services.name: SQLSERVERAGENT
services.what: SQL Server Agent (default instance): runs scheduled SQL Server jobs.
services.ifOff: Scheduled SQL Server jobs do not run.

services.name: SQLAgent$*
services.what: SQL Server Agent for a named instance: runs scheduled SQL Server jobs.
services.ifOff: Scheduled SQL Server jobs do not run.

services.name: SQLBrowser
services.what: SQL Server Browser: tells clients which port each named SQL Server instance listens on.
services.ifOff: Remote clients cannot find named instances by name. Local connections are unaffected.

services.name: MySQL*
services.what: MySQL Server (e.g., MySQL80).
services.ifOff: Apps and projects that use this database cannot connect.

services.name: postgresql-x64-*
services.what: PostgreSQL server (e.g., postgresql-x64-16).
services.ifOff: Apps and projects that use this database cannot connect.

services.name: BraveElevationService
